 This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To
Issue A Writ Order Or Direction In The Nature Of Writ
Of Mandamus, Directing The Respondents To Pay
Damages U/Sec. 19(1) R/W 19(2) Of Right Of Fair
Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act,2013 For Having
Utilized The Land Bearing Sy.No.5/1 To An Extent Of 11
Guntas Of Kulekumatagi For The Formation Of
National Highway. B) Issue A Writ In The Nature Of
Mandamus Directing The Respondents To Consider The
Application Dated 17.07.2018 Produced At Annexure-G
And To Pass Suitable Orders In Accordance With Law.

This Writ Petition Is Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing In 'B' Group, This Day, The Court Made The
Following:

ORDER Heard Sri I.R. Biradar, learned counsel for the petitioner, Smt. Maya T.R., learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent Nos.1 and 2 and Smt. Ratna N.Shivayogimath, learned counsel for respondent Nos.3 and 4.
2.

Writ petition is filed with the following prayer:
'(a) Iissue a writ, order or direction in the nature of writ of mandamus, directing the respondents to pay damages u/sec. 19(1) r/w 19(2) of Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for having utilized the land bearing Sy.No.5/1 to an extent of 11 NC: 2024:KHC-K:2245 guntas of Kulekumatagi village for the formation of national highway.
b) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to consider the application dated 17.07.2018 produced at Annexure-G and to pass suitable orders in accordance with law.

Gurulingayya vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87583184/
2 c) Issue any other suitable writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble Court deems fit under the facts and circumstances of the case including an order of cost."
3. Grievance of the writ petitioner is that his land has been acquired without notifying him for the purpose of formation of National Highway.
4. Petitioner being aggrieved by the said action of the Authorities, filed a writ petition in 206365/2015, which came to be allowed vide Annexure-C and direction was issued to make necessary arrangements for survey and fixing the boundary.
5.

sentences.text: Thereafter, survey was conducted vide Annexure-D and it has been found that in the land of the petitioner, 11 guntas, a road has been formed by the Public Works Department.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:2245 6. Annexure-G is the representation given by the petitioner to pay necessary compensation for having acquired 11 guntas of land.

Till today Annexure-G is not considered and no amount of compensation is paid.
7.
Therefore, a case is made out to consider Annexure-G in accordance with law and pass appropriate order within a time framed.

Hence, following:
ORDER (i) Writ petition is allowed.
(ii) Respondent Nos.3 and 4 are directed to consider Annexure-G and pass appropriate order within a period of two months from today and file compliance report to this Court.

Sd/-
